data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'Gaudius', meaning 'joy' or 'happiness'. In Christian context, it can be interpreted as a name for a brave and strong individual who experiences joy and happiness in their faith. The name Gautious carries the meaning “Brave, Strong” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gautious usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
